none.$description: Sharp 0px corners for full-bleed grids and flush structural dividers

sm.$description: Minimum 4px component corner radius (Shade-DS Radius.S) for checkboxes, menu items, and tooltips

md.$description: Default 8px component corner radius (Shade-DS Radius.M) for cards, alerts, toasts, and textareas

lg.$description: 12px container corner radius (Shade-DS Radius.L) for inputs, dialogs, popovers, and panels

full.$description: Full pill radius (Shade-DS Radius.Full) for buttons, badges, selects, and switches
